title: Checking whether ICL-is-Bayesian generalization bounds predict OOD failure

original_idea.body: Checking whether ICL-is-Bayesian generalization bounds (arXiv:2510.10981) rank-order which synthetic ICL tasks degrade most OOD on a small open model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Predicting silent ICL failures is safety-relevant but the chain to catastrophic risk has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Synthetic ICL tasks + accuracy measurement; mapping bound terms needs some theory depth, guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused correlation deliverable; constructing synthetic function-class tasks adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Foundational ICL-reliability question, open models, no lab data.

novelty.reasoning: Recent theory; empirical OOD-prediction check is a plausibly-open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Theory exists; empirical OOD-prediction test may be open.
